actual_assessment.K: Strongest support: paragraph coherence. 1:31 surveys everything made, 2:1 declares completion, and 2:3 describes seventh-day cessation. A retrospective summary is plausible. Cost: by plus had finished makes an anterior/deadline interpretation prominent where Hebrew repeats the same day phrase. It does not strictly specify completion before the seventh day began, but readers can infer that timeline.
actual_assessment.M: Preserves expressed seventh-day completion and the repeated on-the-seventh-day relation to cessation without supplying new work or its duration. Cost: English readers may hear sequence after 2:1 and wonder why completion follows the already completed universe; M leaves summary/expansion less explicit.
actual_assessment.grammar: Actual general grammar allows sequence, coincident/explanatory narration and summary; contextual anteriority is not compelled or excluded here. Temporal ב does not prescribe an exclusive deadline. No automatic tense-to-English mapping.
actual_assessment.literary_and_readability: M preserves audible repetition; K introduces a by/on contrast not lexically expressed. Both are intelligible modern English; naturalness alone is not decisive.
actual_assessment.strongest_contrary_case: K makes 2:1's completed state clearer. It is not impossible or wholly unsupported; M is preferred because summary followed by specification remains viable without settling that relation in main English.

reviewer_actual_checks: Complete controlling method/doctrine; frozen contract digest; actual primary grammar target sections; connected WLC1:31–2:3 and method/doctrine/WLC pins. Did not read current target YAML, mapping, source-case report, historical reviews or PRs.

root_assessment.reason: The repeated day phrase and active completion statement remain explicit while the retrospective alternative is disclosed. The contextual case for K is real; avoiding an apparent theological contradiction does not make it mandatory.
root_assessment.consistency: Connected POB2:3 already locates cessation on seventh; no broader normalization or fresh certification of adjacent verse notes.
